summary: One church. Both November issues print the same schedule box (Sat 5:30 PM; Sun 7, 9 Spanish, 11:30; weekdays 8:30 AM except Wednesday, plus Saturday 8:30 from the intentions), Saturday confessions and 1st/3rd Sunday Spanish confession. Adoration Mon/Wed/Fri 9-6 in the St. Joseph Adoration Chapel, which the website places in the Parish Center (the former convent) on the church grounds; Fri Nov 27 Mass and Adoration cancelled. No open questions.

entry.note: St. Joseph Adoration Chapel (Parish Center); Benediction

sources.said: Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament is M/W/F 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM in the St. Joseph's Adoration Chapel, unless otherwise noted. Stop by the Parish Center for the code.

Adoration: Monday, Wednesday & Friday after 8:30 AM Mass until 6 PM
Adoration: Monday, Wednesday & Friday after 8:30 AM Mass until 6 PM

This chapel is located in the Parish Center, which was formerly the Convent for the Sisters of Saint Joseph who used to be here at St. Francis ... We currently have Adoration on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9AM to 6PM.

slots.rationale: R1, R38, POLICY Churches and chapels: the p5 clock time 9:00 AM-6:00 PM wins (POLICY, Times; Wednesday has no Mass, so 'after 8:30 AM Mass' can't time it), ending with the 6 PM Benediction. The parish's website puts the chapel in the Parish Center, the parish's former convent, and gives the church's own address as that building's (601 Buttonwood St.), so it is on the church's grounds.
